text:
Priya Patel: Heads-up: copy for the model downgrade confirmation modal needs a pass. Current headline: "Downgrade model?" Body: "You are switching to an older model. Outputs may differ." Feels vague.
Diego: Seen this. We should say what can change (latency, quality, cost) and give a clear next step. Keep it short so modal doesn't feel scary.
Harpreet: Agree. Also call out compatibility risks (e.g., new structured outputs or functions might not be supported). If we can detect breaking features, show a short warning line.
Zoe (eng): Implementation note: we can compute a compatibility flag server-side and show an extra line if non-compatible. Button currently says "Confirm" which is not descriptive.
AccessibilityBot: Reminder: primary action labels should be verb-first and descriptive for screen readers. Use role=alertdialog for confirmations with important consequences.
Priya Patel: Drafts for headline + body + actions:
- Headline: "Switch to older model"
- Body (short): "This version may respond differently and could miss features added in newer models."
- Body (with compat flag): "This change will disable: function calling, structured outputs" (only show items detected)
- Primary action: "Switch model"
- Secondary action: "Cancel"
Diego: Prefer "Switch model" over "Confirm". For the short body, maybe list 2 bullets when space permits: latency, cost, features. Bullets are more scan-friendly.
Harpreet: Bullets OK on desktop but keep to one line on mobile. Suggest default short sentence + expandable details. Eg: "May affect quality, latency, or features. See details."
Zoe (eng): We'll wire the expandable details panel. For i18n, keep code strings without punctuation at the end. Also avoid contractions.
Priya Patel: Final candidate strings for handoff (code-safe):
Main headline: "Switch to older model"
Short body: "This version may affect quality, latency, or features."
Expandable details (optional): "Detected incompatibilities: function calling, structured output. Outputs may differ from the current model."
Primary action: "Switch model"
Secondary action: "Cancel"
Confirmation toast after action: "Model switched. Some features may behave differently."
AccessibilityBot: Also include aria-describedby linking the details region and ensure the action announces the toast result.
Diego: LGTM. Tiny nit: consider using "Switch to older model" as headline if we want the preposition. Test wrapping.
Priya Patel: I'll update the Figma with both headline variants and the expandable details example. Thanks all :sparkles:
